responsibility: Implements GCC’s configured-prefix translation utility used to turn internal installation paths into runtime paths after relocation or package-specific rebasing. It rewrites leading configure-time PREFIX components into keyed @package or $ENV references, resolves those references through environment variables and optional Win32 registry lookups, canonicalizes paths by collapsing certain ../ segments and normalizing directory separators, and provides the update_path/set_std_prefix behavior used by clients that need relocation-aware path computation.
same_name_distinction: Contains the implementation of the prefix utility declared in gcc/prefix.h: it performs configured-prefix rewriting at runtime, resolves @key and $ENV prefixes via environment variables and optional Win32 registry lookups, canonicalizes path components, and normalizes directory separators, rather than just exposing the public interface.
